LI: Starts at LI1 beside the index fingernail, runs between the first two metacarpals (LI4) to the wrist (LI5), up the thumb side of the forearm to the outer end of the elbow crease (LI11), up the outer upper arm to the front of the shoulder (LI15) and over it to LI16. It meets the other yang channels at GV14 below the seventh neck vertebra, then turns forward to ST12 above the collarbone, where a branch goes inward to the lung and the large intestine. The surface branch climbs the neck (LI17, LI18), crosses the cheek into the lower gums, circles the upper lip and crosses the midline at GV26, ending at LI20 beside the opposite nostril.
LU: Begins inside, in the middle burner near CV12. It drops to the large intestine, returns past the stomach, passes through the diaphragm into the lungs and up to the throat, and comes to the surface at LU1 below the outer end of the collarbone. It rises to LU2, runs down the front outer edge of the upper arm (LU3, LU4) to the elbow crease (LU5), along the thumb side of the forearm to the wrist pulse (LU9), over the ball of the thumb (LU10) and ends beside the thumbnail (LU11). A branch leaves at LU7 for the tip of the index finger, where the Large Intestine channel begins.
HT: Begins in the heart. One branch goes down through the diaphragm to the small intestine and another rises beside the throat to the eye. The main course passes through the lung and comes to the surface at HT1 in the centre of the armpit. It runs down the inner edge of the upper arm (HT2) to the inner end of the elbow crease (HT3), along the little-finger side of the forearm to the wrist (HT4 to HT7), across the palm (HT8) and ends beside the little fingernail (HT9), where it links with the Small Intestine channel.
PC: Begins in the chest, in the pericardium, and goes down through the diaphragm to link the upper, middle and lower burners. A branch crosses the chest and comes to the surface at PC1 beside the nipple, curves up around the armpit and runs down the middle of the inner upper arm (PC2) to the elbow crease (PC3), between the two tendons of the forearm (PC4 to PC7) to the centre of the palm (PC8) and the tip of the middle finger (PC9). A branch from the palm goes to the ring finger, where the Triple Burner channel begins.
SI: Starts beside the little fingernail (SI1), runs along the outer edge of the hand (SI2 to SI4) to the wrist (SI5, SI6), up the back of the forearm to the groove at the elbow (SI8), and up the back of the upper arm to the shoulder joint (SI9, SI10). It zigzags over the shoulder blade (SI11 to SI13) to SI14 and SI15 beside the spine, meets the other yang channels at GV14, and turns forward to ST12 above the collarbone, where a branch goes inward to the heart and down to the small intestine. The surface branch climbs the neck (SI16, SI17) to the cheekbone (SI18), reaches the outer corner of the eye at GB1 and turns back into the ear at SI19. A short branch from the cheek runs to the inner corner of the eye (BL1).
TB: Starts beside the ring fingernail (TB1), crosses the back of the hand between the fourth and fifth knuckles (TB2, TB3) to the back of the wrist (TB4), and runs up the middle of the back of the forearm between radius and ulna (TB5 to TB9) to just above the point of the elbow (TB10). It climbs the back of the upper arm (TB11 to TB13) to the back of the shoulder (TB14) and the top of the shoulder blade (TB15), crosses the shoulder through GB21 to ST12, and goes inward to the pericardium and down through the three burners. A branch rises from ST12 up the side of the neck (TB16) and circles behind the ear (TB17 to TB20); another enters the ear and comes out in front of it (TB21, TB22), ending at the outer end of the eyebrow (TB23).
ST: Starts beside the nose at LI20, rises to the inner corner of the eye (BL1) and comes down below the eye (ST1 to ST3) to the corner of the mouth (ST4). It follows the jaw to ST5 and ST6, rises in front of the ear (ST7) to the corner of the forehead (ST8). From ST5 a branch runs down the front of the neck (ST9 to ST11) to ST12 above the collarbone, where a branch goes inward to the stomach and spleen. The surface course runs down the nipple line of the chest (ST13 to ST18), 2 cun beside the midline of the abdomen (ST19 to ST30), down the front of the thigh (ST31 to ST34), past the knee (ST35) and down the outside of the shin (ST36 to ST40) to the front of the ankle (ST41), across the top of the foot (ST42, ST43) and ends beside the second toenail (ST45). A branch from ST42 goes to the big toe, where the Spleen channel begins.
SP: Starts beside the big toenail (SP1), runs along the inner edge of the foot (SP2 to SP4) to the front of the inner ankle (SP5), up behind the edge of the tibia (SP6 to SP9) and the inner thigh (SP10, SP11) to the groin (SP12). It climbs the abdomen 4 cun from the midline (SP13 to SP16), where a branch goes inward to the spleen and stomach and on through the diaphragm to the throat and the root of the tongue. The surface course continues up the chest 6 cun from the midline (SP17 to SP20) and turns down to end on the side of the chest (SP21).
KI: Starts under the little toe, crosses the sole to KI1, comes up to the inner edge of the foot (KI2) and circles behind the inner ankle (KI3 to KI6). It rises up the back of the inner calf (KI7 to KI9) to the inner end of the knee crease (KI10) and up the inner thigh. Inside, it runs to the tip of the spine, up to the kidney and down to the bladder, then surfaces at the top of the pubic bone (KI11). It climbs 0.5 cun from the midline of the abdomen (KI11 to KI21) and 2 cun from the midline of the chest (KI22 to KI26), ending below the collarbone (KI27). An inner branch rises from the kidney through the liver and diaphragm into the lung, the throat and the root of the tongue.
BL: Starts at the inner corner of the eye (BL1), rises over the forehead (BL2 to BL5) and the top of the head (BL6 to BL8), where a branch meets GV20 and enters the brain, and comes down the back of the head (BL9) to the nape (BL10). There it splits. The inner line runs 1.5 cun beside the spine (BL11 to BL30, the Back-Shu points), through the sacral foramina (BL31 to BL34) and past the coccyx (BL35), then down the back of the thigh (BL36 to BL39) to the back of the knee (BL40). The outer line runs 3 cun beside the spine (BL41 to BL54) and down the back of the thigh to join it at BL40. From there the channel runs down the calf (BL55 to BL59), behind the outer ankle (BL60), along the outer edge of the foot (BL61 to BL66) and ends beside the little toenail (BL67). A branch goes inward from the lower back to the kidney and bladder.
LR: Starts beside the big toenail (LR1), crosses the top of the foot between the first two toes (LR2, LR3) to the front of the inner ankle (LR4), runs up the inner surface of the tibia (LR5, LR6) to the inner knee (LR7, LR8) and up the inner thigh (LR9 to LR11) to the groin (LR12). Inside, it curves around the genitals and up through the lower abdomen past the stomach, surfacing at the free end of the eleventh rib (LR13) and ending in the sixth intercostal space below the nipple (LR14). An internal branch continues to the liver and gallbladder, through the diaphragm and the throat to the eye, and up to the top of the head at GV20.
GB: Starts at the outer corner of the eye (GB1), drops in front of the ear (GB2, GB3), climbs the temple hairline (GB4 to GB7), circles above and behind the ear (GB8 to GB12), crosses forward to the forehead (GB13, GB14), runs back over the head 2.25 cun from the midline (GB15 to GB19) to the base of the skull (GB20) and down to the top of the shoulder (GB21). From GB21 it goes forward to ST12 above the collarbone, where a branch goes inward through the chest to the liver and gallbladder. The surface course comes down the side of the chest (GB22 to GB24), the flank (GB25, GB26) and the hip (GB27 to GB30), runs down the outside of the thigh (GB31 to GB33) and leg (GB34 to GB39) to the front of the outer ankle (GB40), crosses the top of the foot (GB41 to GB43) and ends beside the fourth toenail (GB44). A branch from GB41 goes to the big toe, where the Liver channel begins.
CV: Begins inside the lower abdomen and comes to the surface at the perineum (CV1). It runs straight up the front midline over the pubic bone (CV2), the lower abdomen (CV3 to CV7), the navel (CV8), the upper abdomen (CV9 to CV15), the breastbone (CV16 to CV21) and the throat (CV22, CV23) to the hollow below the lower lip (CV24). Inside, it circles the lips and divides to rise to below the eyes (ST1).
GV: Begins inside the lower abdomen, emerges at the perineum (CV1) and goes back to below the tip of the coccyx (GV1). It runs straight up the back midline over the sacrum (GV2), the lumbar and thoracic spine (GV3 to GV13) to GV14 below the seventh neck vertebra, up the back of the neck (GV15, GV16) and over the head (GV17 to GV20, where it enters the brain) and forehead (GV21 to GV24), down the nose (GV25) to the upper lip (GV26, GV27), and ends inside the mouth where the upper lip meets the gum (GV28).
